title: Due Diligence Checks by Banks and Safeguards Such As Deduction Limits for GIRO Transactions
what_it_is: Due Diligence Checks by Banks and Safeguards Such As Deduction Limits for GIRO Transactions

sections.label: GIRO limits and due diligence
sections.summary: Customers can set transaction limits on GIRO payments, and banks apply due diligence checks on GIRO billing organisations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Customers can set transaction limits on their GIRO payments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And banks also apply due diligence checks on GIRO billing organisations.

sections.label: Strengthening GIRO safeguards
sections.summary: MAS is working with the Association of Banks in Singapore and member banks to strengthen safeguards, considering monthly limits and enhanced monitoring and due diligence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: While such cases have been uncommon so far, we agree that the safeguards should be strengthened.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is working with the Association of Banks in Singapore and member banks to strengthen safeguards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The review will consider measures including enabling customers to set monthly limits on the value and number of transactions and enhancing transaction monitoring and due diligence on billing organisations.

sections.label: Looking into suggestions
sections.summary: The speaker says they will look into her suggestion and others as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Indeed, we will look into her suggestion and others as well.

sections.label: Public awareness and review timing
sections.summary: The review will start with lower-hanging fruits, some effected short term, while major system changes need time to be developed, tested and implemented.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, can public awareness be increased prior to the review being completed?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And in the review, we will start with lower-hanging fruits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Some of these may be effected in the short term, but major enhancements which involve system changes will need some time to be developed, tested and implemented.
